title: Get body/freestyle libre temperature...
body:
Hello,
Just wondering if we can get the sensor/body temperature and display it on main screen....

comments.body: I don't think Libre has a temperature sensor, does it?
The Libre sensors have a temperature sensor but the values are not provided over BLE or NFC.

Thanks

I had been told that the Libre CGM was sensitive to temperature because it had no temperature compensation.
If there is a sensor, I don't understand why there is no temperature compensation.

Indeed, there is a temperature compensation implemented in the firmware. But compensation likely fails for situations like warm or ice bath. xDrip cannot compensate raw values by temperature because the values are not exposed.

It looks like it is possible.

@tzachi-dar Can you have a look at it?

I'm going to convert this to a discussion.
The conversation can continue there.
